tests: All eight symbols have their documented exact weight on the 100-point draw
6,000 generated matrices agree with an independent prefix-matching oracle in all three modes
A Wild substitutes normal symbols, Bonus never substitutes, and lines must begin on the first reel
Only the best payline awards lives even when all 15 lines win, with one atomic result per spin
A pending chest survives reload, blocks spins, and can be claimed exactly once
Crystal awards three saved bonus spins, consumes one per spin and never retriggers within bonus spins
Forge keeps both selected reel columns stationary and redraws only the other three
Mission claims survive reload without duplicate rewards and respect the balance ceiling
Automatic runs are finite and stop after exactly five or ten committed spins
Stopping automatic play preserves the current result and prevents further spins
An automatic run stops before spin 51 and resumes only after the ad-break callback
New bonus features stop an automatic sequence before another result is committed
Leaving or hiding the screen cancels pending animation and auto callbacks without losing a prize
Mode and page switches are blocked during a spin, and result presentation never changes saved state
Legacy slot statistics, lives and in-progress crosswords migrate without replaying a prize
New result matrices and all history entries survive a saved-session round trip
scope: Exact production script with DOM/event adapters. No browser geometry or device audio is simulated.
